title: ErvisioCode
subtitle: Manage your Remote devices from any browser, even when your computer is off.
devices.title: Authorized devices
devices.description: Only devices linked to this ErvisioRepo account. Remote status refreshes while this tab is visible.
devices.empty: No devices yet. Use /account on your computer to get a device code.
setup.title: Set up Remote
setup.account: Run this in ErvisioCode on your computer and choose Sign in. Use the same ErvisioRepo account to enter and approve the code.
setup.remote: Open a session on your computer and run this command to start Remote. Keep ErvisioCode running to stay online.
setup.limits: This page shows device status. It doesn’t run code or sync session history.
legacy.title: QR or pairing link
legacy.description: To use Remote without linking an account, scan the QR code or open the pairing link shown in ErvisioCode. Those connections won’t appear here.
